description: Hi! I’m Arin, a first-year CSE student passionate about space exploration and technology. building something meaningful for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.I’m exploring an interactive visualization focused on the Moon and Mars I’m still developing the idea and would love teammates who can help shape the concept, choose useful NASA data, and create an intuitive app Beginners are welcome. Teammates based in Pune city would be especially welcome, though anyone enthusiastic about space exploration
